output.notes: Described DeepSeek-V2 (236B total, 21B active) as the headline model; DeepSeek-V2-Lite listed as second config (it does not compress queries, so W^DQ/W^UQ become a plain W^Q; 64 routed experts). Norm type/placement and SwiGLU activation are inherited from DeepSeek 67B via the explicit 'follows the settings' sentence; eps, rope theta/pairing, biases, tying left not_stated. n_kv_heads not_stated because MLA uses per-head keys from a shared 512-dim latent rather than a KV-head count. Vocab '100K' is written approximately in the paper. Context 4096 is the pretraining length; extended to 128K via YaRN (Lite chat 32K). d_ff is the per-expert intermediate size. Projection widths 16384/8192 are n_h*d_h and n_h*d_h^R computed from stated values.
